# Skill Tester

Executable validation workflow for Codex skills.

## Capabilities

- Static contract checks for `SKILL.md` (frontmatter, trigger wording, workflow sections)
- Trigger regression checks from test cases (`query -> expected skill/keywords`)
- Optional semantic audit (LLM mode)
- Machine-readable reports (`json` + `markdown`)

## Input Requirements

- Target skill path
- Test case file (`sample_test_cases.json` style)
- Optional runner command for end-to-end trigger replay

## Test Case Schema

```json
[
  {
    "id": "trigger_code_review",
    "query": "Please review this pull request",
    "expectedSkill": "code-review",
    "expectedKeywords": ["review"],
    "forbiddenKeywords": ["financial"]
  }
]
```

## How to Use

### 1) Static checks only

```bash
node .codex/skills/skill-tester/scripts/run-skill-tests.js \
  --skill-path .codex/skills/skill-debugger
```

### 2) Trigger regression with command replay

Use a runner command template with placeholders:

- `{query}`: raw query text
- `{query_escaped}`: shell-escaped query text

```bash
node .codex/skills/skill-tester/scripts/run-skill-tests.js \
  --skill-path .codex/skills/skill-debugger \
  --cases .codex/skills/skill-tester/sample_test_cases.json \
  --runner-cmd "printf 'skill-debugger\\ntrigger description\\nquery=%s\\n' {query_escaped}"
```

### 3) Built-in Claude runner

```bash
node .codex/skills/skill-tester/scripts/run-skill-tests.js \
  --skill-path .codex/skills/skill-tester \
  --cases .codex/skills/skill-tester/sample_test_cases.json \
  --runner claude
```

### 3) Hybrid mode (static + semantic)

```bash
OPENAI_API_KEY=... node .codex/skills/skill-tester/scripts/run-skill-tests.js \
  --skill-path .codex/skills/skill-debugger \
  --cases .codex/skills/skill-tester/sample_test_cases.json \
  --mode hybrid
```

## Output

- `.omcodex/reports/skill-tester-latest.json`
- `.omcodex/reports/skill-tester-latest.md`

Exit code behavior:

- `0`: all checks pass
- `1`: any static/trigger/semantic gate fails

## Trigger Replay Guidance

Use `--runner` for built-in integrations or `--runner-cmd` for custom integrations.

Examples:

```bash
# Placeholder for Codex CLI integration
--runner-cmd "codex exec --json {query_escaped}"

# Built-in Claude CLI integration
--runner claude
```

Tune assertions in `sample_test_cases.json` using `expectedSkill`, `expectedKeywords`, and `forbiddenKeywords`.

## Recommended Workflow

1. Run static checks on every skill edit.
2. Run trigger regression before merging.
3. Run hybrid mode on release candidates.
4. Store reports as regression evidence.

## Related Skills

- `skill-quality-analyzer`: broader quality scoring
- `skill-debugger`: root-cause analysis when trigger tests fail
- `skill-development`: authoring and refinement workflow
